outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, merge); no quantitative plot with averaged data is present.

The JC-1 (Green/Red ratio) and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts show only mean bars with error bars (n=20 stated) but no individual data points are overlaid, obscuring the spread of the underlying measurements.
Panel C is a Western blot image; it contains no averaged quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts display only means with error bars and sample sizes noted in the bars, but no individual data points are shown for the underlying measurements.

Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) for individual replicate experiments; these are distribution/frequency plots (akin to line plots) rather than bar charts of averaged data, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
